register_transport_model: register a pydantic transport model class with TORAX config for dynamic model registration
build_transport_model: build a transport model by registering a pydantic model that inherits from TransportBase
configure_transport_model: configure a transport model via pydantic after registering it with TORAX
combine_transport_models: combine multiple registered transport models in a CombinedTransportModel config
rebuild_model_annotations: rebuild pydantic model annotations dynamically after registering a new transport model
